PRO_FINAL: PARK_CURRENT_FACTORIZATION
Final decision

The smallest evidence-supported disposition is PARK_CURRENT_FACTORIZATION.

The exact-population association-information question remains closed at its existing narrow boundary. The finite-resource reopening tested the strongest surviving alternative for the current association factorization: whether, under matched samples, targets, parameter count, initialization, optimizer state, update count, and evaluator exposure, it estimates conditional value and source credit more effectively than a competent containing critic. On the one valid seed, it did not. GENERIC_PAIR was more accurate on every registered direct estimation diagnostic, while both critics were already decision-competent. The factorized arm’s sole favorable result was a larger temperature-one softmax gap and therefore higher enumerated utility.

This supports parking this factorization and local continuation path, not declaring that every structured factorization must fail. The claim remains confined to one four-agent censored-substitution host, one seed, 192 training episodes, 128 updates per 32-parameter critic, 256 evaluation episodes, and the temperature-one evaluator. No stable factorization failure, general relay-information conclusion, compute-efficiency result, transfer claim, or deployment claim is supported. 

PROMPT_BODY

Strongest supporting observation

The strongest support is the conjunction of the historical containment result and the new finite-resource result:

The historical exact-population work found that, once relation representation and evidence are shared, competent generic conditioning absorbs the association update in all three frozen families. Finite-data approximation efficiency was explicitly retained as the strongest distinct future alternative, rather than as a continuation of the relay-information claim. See
docs/research/candidates/expressibility_gated_renewal_credit_relay/evidence/2026-08-29-four-successor-03-convergence-disposition.md at commit abcc7c27c6b7d610794f9727d4daef3a6a545564, especially “Objection 4,” “Strongest evidence against the null,” and “Recommendation mapping.”

B01 then directly tested that finite-resource alternative. Both arms attained 8/8 greedy competence, but GENERIC_PAIR had:

Q RMSE 0.0527587559 versus 0.0962653460;

maximum Q error 0.1460960706 versus 0.2827973564;

source-gradient L2 error 0.0523571133 versus 0.0982021395; and

slightly better scale-free gradient orientation, cosine 0.9945215316 versus 0.9923031656.

Thus the current factorization lost not only magnitude-sensitive Q error but also the reported direction diagnostic. The signed estimation differences were both adverse: Delta_Q=-0.0435065901 and Delta_g=-0.0458450262. See
docs/research/candidates/expressibility_gated_renewal_credit_relay/EGRCR_FINITE_RESOURCE_CENSORED_SUBSTITUTION_B01_RESULT_EVIDENCE_20260904.md at the pinned commit, lines 80–155, §§ “Primary observations” and “Frozen rule applied verbatim.”

The current direction authority consequently records “no clean finite-resource factorization polarity,” direct estimation favoring generic, and a clean decision boundary rather than authorization for unchanged replication. See DIRECTION.md, pinned commit, lines 20–55, § “Section-11 finite-resource cycle.”

Strongest contradiction

The strongest contradiction to parking is real and must be retained:

ASSOCIATION_FACTOR assigned probability 0.6825671204 to the matching relation versus 0.6644999725 for GENERIC_PAIR.

Its exactly enumerated expected utility was 0.4550447470 versus 0.4429999817, giving Delta_U=+0.0120447653.

The paired sampled utility nevertheless tied at 0.484375, and both arms made the same correct greedy decision in all eight contexts.

This positive exact utility difference prevents a stronger statement that the factorized arm was uniformly inferior. It does not, however, establish factorization value: the evaluator rewards a larger already-correct action gap, and the result document explicitly notes that learned predictions can exceed the exact-Q reference’s temperature-one utility merely by inflating that gap. The exact-Q reference itself scored only 0.4405042458, despite being exact.

Scale/calibration judgment

Scale/calibration is a plausible explanatory uncertainty for B01, but RECAST_SCALE_CONTROLLED_B02 would be a post-hoc efficacy rescue rather than the next warranted EGRCR experiment.

The distinction is:

As an interpretation, scale inflation is decision-relevant because it explains why a less accurate critic received a higher value from this particular smooth policy transform.

As a new treatment hypothesis, it is not presently supported. A common-temperature, common-gap, or trust-map-controlled B02 would change the question from finite-data conditional-Q/source-gradient estimation to policy calibration after the treatment lost both registered estimation comparisons. The intake explicitly identifies that change of question and warns that such an object cannot repair B01. See
EGRCR_FINITE_RESOURCE_CENSORED_SUBSTITUTION_B01_INTAKE_20260904.md, pinned commit, lines 45–135, §§ “Scientific update,” “Flags for the owner,” and “Recommended direction-tier question.”

Section 11 permits outcome-informed revision between named B runs, so the issue is not procedural inadmissibility. The issue is scientific value: permissibility does not make an evaluator-specific recalibration run evidence for association credit or estimator efficiency. Moreover, the already-reported gradient cosine gives a scale-insensitive directional check and favors GENERIC_PAIR; there is no observed scale-free treatment signal requiring a new local run. Section 11 supports B iteration when it answers a named uncertainty, but it does not require replication or recasting after every mixed endpoint. See MARL_EMPIRICAL_EVIDENCE_SPEC.md, pinned commit, lines 300–390, §§ 11.1–11.4.

Residual uncertainty

The following remains unresolved:

whether the +0.0120448 temperature-one utility difference would repeat across independent seeds;

whether another prospectively specified factorization, budget, or optimization geometry could yield a genuine scale-invariant decision benefit;

whether independently motivated policy calibration is useful as a generic optimizer mechanism outside EGRCR; and

how the two critics compare under matched arithmetic or measured peak memory.

None of those uncertainties reverses this disposition. One seed cannot establish stable failure, but parking does not require such a claim; it requires that no currently specified local object offers enough independent decision value. Missing peak RSS and unequal forward arithmetic prohibit resource conclusions but do not annul the valid non-resource result.

No-next-run rationale

No local run is warranted now:

CONTINUE_UNCHANGED_REPLICATION is rejected. The frozen card reserved unchanged three-seed replication for FRCS-A-FACTORIZED-ENDPOINT-GAIN. B01 instead produced FRCS-D-MIXED, with both estimation differences negative.

RECAST_SCALE_CONTROLLED_B02 is rejected for this direction. It would replace the tested estimator-efficiency question with outcome-informed policy-temperature calibration, while the existing scale-free diagnostic already provides no treatment-favorable indication.

No telemetry rerun is justified. Peak RSS and an external detached exit code are irrelevant to the accepted non-resource estimand, and rerunning solely to obtain them cannot change the scientific decision.

No exact-population family should be reopened. That family remains historical closed evidence, not a source of current negative polarity beyond its stated finite boundary.

Re-entry would require a separately authorized, prospectively motivated factorization or decision mechanism that predicts a scale-invariant native allocation or utility advantage under a predeclared common calibration/trust map and a competent containing same-information comparator. Such an object would be new evidence, not B01 replication or repair.
